title: 1-Lipschitz exhaustion function of an open set U ⊆ ℝ^P (Simon 6.2 proof: φ > 0 in U, {φ > λ} ⊂⊂ U)
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∃ φ : Eucl P → ℝ, LipschitzWith 1 φ ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → IsCompact {x | t ≤ φ x} ∧ {x | t ≤ φ x} ⊆ U) ∧ ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, δ ≤ φ x
